ratios.quote: At June 30, 2026 , Ashland’s calculation of the consolidated net leverage ratio was 2.3 .
At June 30, 2026 , Ashland’s calculation of the consolidated interest coverage ratio was 6.9 .

parsed.notes: Both ratios are disclosed twice, in the debt note and in MD&A, with the same values. The limits (max 4.0x net leverage, min 3.0x interest coverage) come from adjacent sentences. Ratios are calculated on Covenant Adjusted EBITDA as defined in the 2026 Credit Agreement, which differs from reported EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA. The Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio also sets the pricing grid for interest margins and fees; that use is excluded. The company states it was in compliance at June 30, 2026.
